help.question: Can CitizenDesk India help me choose the correct authority?
help.answer: Yes. It helps you understand the authority that usually handles your issue and what to prepare before filing.

government.question: Is CitizenDesk India a government website?
government.answer: No. It is an independent guidance platform and links users to official resources.

file.question: Will CitizenDesk India file complaints for me?
file.answer: No. It provides guidance only. Users must submit complaints through official portals or authorities.

categories.question: Which complaint categories are supported?
categories.answer: Consumer, CPGRAMS, INGRAM, RTI, Banking, Insurance, Railways, Passport, Electricity, Pension and more.

privacy.question: Is my personal information stored?
privacy.answer: The public site does not require complaint details. Future assisted workflows should collect only what is necessary.

aboutValues.title: Clarity before action
aboutValues.body: Understand the right authority, process, and next step before filing or escalating a grievance.

aboutValues.title: Respect for official process
aboutValues.body: Use the appropriate grievance channel and follow the published procedure before escalating.

aboutValues.title: Privacy by design
aboutValues.body: Share only the information necessary for your grievance and avoid exposing sensitive personal details.

aboutValues.title: Plain-language civic education
aboutValues.body: Turn complicated grievance systems into practical guidance that ordinary citizens can understand and use.

pages.aboutText: CitizenDesk India exists to make grievance procedures easier to understand, without pretending to be a government portal or legal adviser.
pages.contactText: Send corrections, suggestions, partnership ideas, and platform feedback.
pages.privacyText: Your privacy matters. CitizenDesk India is designed to minimize data collection and guide users responsibly.

privacySections.title: Information you share
privacySections.body: Use only the information needed to understand your grievance. Do not share passwords, OTPs, full identity numbers, or other unnecessary sensitive details.

privacySections.title: How this platform is used
privacySections.body: CitizenDesk India provides general guidance and links to official resources. It is not a government department or legal adviser.

privacySections.title: External services
privacySections.body: Official links may lead to services with their own privacy practices. Review those notices before submitting information.

pages.termsText: These terms explain acceptable use, disclaimers, external links, and platform limitations.

termsSections.title: Guidance only
termsSections.body: CitizenDesk India provides general information, not legal advice, official decisions, or a guarantee of any grievance outcome.

termsSections.title: Use official channels
termsSections.body: Verify procedures with the relevant authority and submit complaints through official channels when required.

termsSections.title: Responsible use
termsSections.body: Do not submit unnecessary sensitive data or rely on this platform as a substitute for emergency, legal, or official assistance.

confidence.eyebrow: Your complaint can make a difference
confidence.title: People who don't give up
confidence.text: These illustrative scenarios show how a documented complaint, sent through the right channel, can create a clearer path forward. They are not promises of outcome.

pension.title: Pension payment restored after documented follow-up
pension.body: A retired citizen keeps the pension reference, bank entries, life certificate proof, and earlier replies before escalating to the appropriate pension grievance route.
pension.lesson: Lesson: keep reference numbers and show the full timeline.

banking.title: Failed transaction dispute moved beyond branch visits
banking.body: A customer first files with the bank in writing, waits for the response window, then prepares an escalation with transaction references and the bank complaint number.
banking.lesson: Lesson: regulators usually expect the bank process first.

consumer.title: Defective product complaint becomes clearer with evidence
consumer.body: A buyer records invoice details, warranty promises, photos, and seller messages before using the consumer grievance path.
consumer.lesson: Lesson: evidence makes the request specific and easier to examine.

evidence.title: What should I keep as evidence?
evidence.text: Dates, receipts, application numbers, screenshots, photos, letters, and names of offices contacted.

noResponse.title: What if there is no response?
noResponse.text: Follow the stated timeline, keep proof of submission, then escalate through the published grievance route.

escalate.title: When should I escalate?
escalate.text: Escalate after the first authority has had a fair chance to respond, or when the official process allows appeal.

confidence.trust: CitizenDesk India is not a government department and does not guarantee any decision. AI and rule-based guidance can contain errors, so verify official links and do not share passwords, OTPs, full identity numbers, or unnecessary sensitive details.

consumer.firstStep: Write to the seller or service provider with the problem and the remedy you want.
consumer.escalation: Use the appropriate consumer grievance route if the written response does not resolve the issue.
consumer.draftFocus: the defective product or service and the specific remedy requested.

cpgrams.firstStep: Submit a concise grievance to the concerned department with the original reference number.
cpgrams.escalation: Track the acknowledgement and use the published escalation mechanism if the response is inadequate.
cpgrams.draftFocus: the delayed public service and the action or explanation requested.

ingram.firstStep: Record the issue with the company through its published customer support channel.
ingram.escalation: Use the applicable consumer escalation path after allowing a reasonable response period.
ingram.draftFocus: the unresolved consumer issue and the remedy requested.

rti.firstStep: Send a focused RTI application to the correct public authority or public information officer.
rti.escalation: Use the first appeal process when a response is not received or is incomplete.
rti.draftFocus: the specific information requested from the public authority.

banking.firstStep: File a written complaint through the bank's official grievance channel.
banking.escalation: Consider the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme only after the bank process and eligibility requirements are met.
banking.draftFocus: the disputed banking issue and the correction or explanation requested.

insurance.firstStep: Submit the concern to the insurer's grievance channel with the policy and claim details.
insurance.escalation: Follow the insurer's published escalation route and check the appropriate ombudsman process where relevant.
insurance.draftFocus: the unresolved insurance claim or service issue and the requested action.

railways.firstStep: Report the journey-linked issue through the relevant railway passenger support channel.
railways.escalation: Keep the acknowledgement and follow the published passenger grievance route.
railways.draftFocus: the journey-specific service issue and the action requested.

passport.firstStep: Check the Passport Seva application status and raise the issue through the official support route.
passport.escalation: Use the published Passport Seva grievance or escalation channel if the issue remains unresolved.
passport.draftFocus: the passport application issue and the clarification or action requested.

electricity.firstStep: Raise a written complaint with the local electricity distribution company.
electricity.escalation: Use the distribution company's published escalation route and the applicable regulator process if needed.
electricity.draftFocus: the electricity service or billing issue and the correction requested.

pension.firstStep: Submit a written grievance to the concerned pension office or service channel with your pension reference.
pension.escalation: Use the relevant pension grievance escalation route after preserving proof of each submission.
pension.draftFocus: the pension payment or service issue and the action requested.

successStories.realMetaTitle: Documented Public Consumer Cases | CitizenDesk India
successStories.realMetaDescription: Independently reported Indian consumer cases with links to the original report or published order.
successStories.realIntro: These summaries are based on independently reported public cases and published orders. They are not CitizenDesk India matters, legal advice, or a promise of a similar outcome.
successStories.independentNotice: Outcomes depend on the facts, evidence, applicable law, and any review or appeal. Read the original source before relying on a summary.
successStories.metaDescription: Illustrative citizen grievance pathways showing how evidence, the right authority, and responsible follow-up can help clarify the next step.
successStories.title: Successful Citizen Stories
successStories.intro: These anonymized examples are based on typical grievance pathways. They show how a clear record, the right authority, and measured follow-up can help citizens move forward. They are not promises of any outcome.
successStories.illustrativeNotice: Every story below is an illustrative example, not a verified case record.

rightAuthority.title: Start with the right authority
rightAuthority.text: A complaint is easier to examine when it begins in the published first-level channel.

documented.title: Keep the record together
documented.text: Dates, references, receipts, messages, and responses create a clear trail.

followUp.title: Follow the stated process
followUp.text: Use the published response window and escalation route before moving further.

successStories.ctaTitle: Find the right path for your complaint
successStories.ctaText: Start with the Complaint Finder to identify a likely authority, documents to keep, and a sensible next step.

stories.title: A defective appliance complaint becomes specific
stories.problem: A purchased appliance repeatedly failed during its warranty period and the seller only gave verbal assurances.
stories.authority: The seller or service provider first, followed by the appropriate consumer grievance route if needed.
stories.action: The buyer sent a dated written request describing the defect and the remedy sought, then kept the submission reference.
stories.evidence: Invoice, warranty terms, photos or video of the fault, service records, and seller messages.
stories.process: Written first-level complaint, a reasonable response window, then the relevant consumer route if unresolved.
stories.outcome: The complaint record gave the buyer a clearer, evidence-led basis for the next official step.
stories.lesson: Ask for a specific remedy and preserve proof of each contact.

stories.title: A transaction dispute moves beyond branch visits
stories.problem: A customer had a disputed transaction but received only informal responses during branch visits.
stories.authority: The bank's grievance channel first, then the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme where eligibility and timelines allow.
stories.action: The customer filed a written complaint with the bank and waited for the published response period before considering escalation.
stories.evidence: Transaction reference, account statement, complaint acknowledgement, dates of contact, and any bank replies.
stories.process: Bank complaint, documented follow-up, then a regulator route only after the bank process has had a fair chance to respond.
stories.outcome: The documented path made it easier to show what had already been tried and what remained unresolved.
stories.lesson: Regulatory escalation usually depends on a complete first-level record.

stories.title: A service issue is reported with journey details
stories.problem: A traveller needed to report a service issue connected to a specific train journey.
stories.authority: The relevant railway passenger grievance channel, using the journey-specific reporting path where available.
stories.action: The traveller recorded the coach, train, date, and issue while preserving the ticket and any acknowledgement.
stories.evidence: Ticket or PNR details, time and location, photos where appropriate, and the complaint reference.
stories.process: Prompt journey-linked report, acknowledgement tracking, and follow-up through the published passenger support channel.
stories.outcome: The report became easier to route because it included the details needed to identify the service context.
stories.lesson: For time-sensitive service issues, record the journey facts as early as possible.

stories.title: A delayed service request is organized for follow-up
stories.problem: A citizen had submitted a government service request but could not get a clear status update.
stories.authority: The concerned department's grievance channel, or the appropriate public grievance route for the service.
stories.action: The citizen assembled the original application number, timeline, and prior replies before submitting a concise grievance.
stories.evidence: Application acknowledgement, relevant receipts, correspondence, service portal screenshots, and dates.
stories.process: Department-level grievance, reference tracking, then the published escalation mechanism if the response is inadequate.
stories.outcome: A concise timeline helped focus the grievance on the missing action or explanation.
stories.lesson: A short chronology often makes an administrative complaint easier to understand.
